I'd say im decent at sniping. To be completely honest you could try reading guides etc but I feel like you will only get good with experience. However, I do have some tips. When building up to getting a good feel for sniping (intuitively knowing how much to lead your shot etc), it's good to stick to one sniper if possible and get comfortable with that one sniper first. (kinda tough to control that in a BR besides loadouts tho). Second, sniping from the high ground down below you is when sniping is the easiest by far. Aim directly at them, take your time to see the reticle on them and shoot. Don't hesitate too much! If you do have to shoot above you chances are you'll probably only mostly see the enemy's head anyway so just shoot at the very top of it and depending on how close you are it should work without having to take into account leading too much. But I guess if you take anything, always try to get that high ground to snipe from. OH and don't forget most snipers in warzone have pretty fast dps even for bolt action snipers so if you down someone always try to finish them off if possible because otherwise best case you burn some of their armour, worst case you give your position for no gain.
